headline: Argentina Cereal Exporters Project 10% Drop in 2026 Inflows
summary: Agro-exporters in Argentina project foreign exchange inflows of $28.2 billion in 2026, marking a 10% decline from the previous year due to lower international prices and Black Sea conflict dynamics.
why: Grain export revenues are the primary source of foreign currency for Argentina's economy, directly impacting trade balances and domestic monetary policy.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Lower export revenues reduce foreign currency inflows into the domestic economy.
